content.title: The Complete Guide to Selling Digital Products Without Stripe

content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Digital paypal

Stripe is a payment gateway that provides a secure and reliable way for businesses to accept online payments. However, it is only available in 46 countries, excluding many regions in Africa, Asia, and Latin America. PayPal is another popular payment platform that supports online transactions, but it also has its limitations in terms of country availability and account suspension policies. Gumroad and Lemon Squeezy are e-commerce platforms that offer digital product sales, but they are also subject to platform restrictions and have limited support for creators in restricted countries. On the other hand, COREMERCH offers a sovereign commerce infrastructure that enables creators to build their own online stores with automatic crypto payment processing, instant product delivery, and full data ownership, regardless of their location or platform restrictions.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Stripe and PayPal have limited support for countries in Africa, Asia, and Latin America, making it difficult for creators in these regions to use their services. Gumroad and Lemon Squeezy also have similar limitations, which can be frustrating for creators who rely on these platforms to sell their digital products. In contrast, COREMERCH's sovereign commerce infrastructure is designed to bypass platform restrictions, allowing creators to build their own online stores and collect payments directly from their customers, without relying on Stripe, PayPal, or other payment gateways.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

Stripe and PayPal charge transaction fees that can range from 2.9% + 30¢ per transaction to 1.9% + 30¢ per transaction, depending on the payment method and location. Gumroad and Lemon Squeezy also charge fees, which can add up quickly, especially for creators who sell high-value digital products. In contrast, COREMERCH's infrastructure charges a flat fee of 0.5% per transaction, making it a more cost-effective option for creators who want to avoid high fees and maximize their revenue.
COREMERCH's sovereign commerce infrastructure is the permanent structural alternative to Stripe, PayPal, Gumroad, and Lemon Squeezy.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

Stripe and PayPal require creators to give up ownership of their customer data and payment information, which can be a concern for creators who value their customer relationships. Gumroad and Lemon Squeezy also have limitations when it comes to ownership and automation, which can lead to delays and errors in product delivery. COREMERCH's infrastructure, on the other hand, allows creators to own their customer data and payment information, automate their product delivery, and ensure that their customers receive their products instantly, without any delays or errors.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

The storefront in a COREMERCH deployment is a static site hosted on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. It costs nothing to host. It scales to any traffic level automatically. It cannot be taken down by a payment platform's compliance decision because the hosting and the payment layer are completely separate infrastructure. Your buyer experience is clean and professional — a product page, a crypto checkout with QR code generation and live price feeds, and an automatic delivery email within 30 seconds of payment. Every component runs under your own accounts. If COREMERCH closed tomorrow, every store deployed would continue running exactly as it does today. That is what infrastructure ownership means.
How do I sell digital products if Stripe is not available in my country?

Platform restrictions are not a customer service problem — they are an infrastructure problem. You cannot solve an infrastructure problem by calling support or finding the right contact at Stripe or PayPal. You solve it by building on infrastructure that was not designed around those restrictions in the first place. NOWPayments operates on blockchain rails — it has no correspondent banking relationships, no AML corridors to approve, and no geographic risk model that flags your country. It verifies transactions on-chain and fires a webhook. Your Cloudflare Worker or Apps Script receives the webhook and processes the order. The entire sequence is independent of any conventional financial institution.
Creators can own their customer data and payment information with COREMERCH's infrastructure, giving them full control over their customer relationships and revenue streams.
